featured.title: Cassian
featured.description: A self-healing batch platform on AWS Spot. Checkpointed jobs recover on EKS, with On-Demand fallback when interruption limits are reached.
featured.note: Spot capacity. Durable progress. Observable recovery.

featured.title: Synapse
featured.description: A document-grounded chat workspace, shipped through GitHub Actions, ECR, and Helm to EKS with asynchronous workers and autoscaling.
featured.note: From a commit to a running workload.

featured.title: Morlana
featured.description: Recoverable folder history in C++. Content-addressed snapshots, bounded parallel capture, and integrity-checked restores for local files.

featured.title: Kessel
featured.description: F1 counterfactuals as a Kubernetes workload. A FastAPI control plane dispatches reproducible parallel simulations and aggregates the results.

featured.title: logfold
featured.description: Less log noise, more signal. A Rust CLI that normalizes changing values and folds repetitive lines into counted patterns.
featured.note: Find the pattern in the noise.

featured.title: table-lyft
featured.description: A browser extension that turns loaded HTML tables into reusable data: pick, preview, filter, and export to CSV, Markdown, or the clipboard.
featured.note: From web table to something useful.
